title: growing¶
content:
growing¶

Animations that introduce mobjects to scene by growing them from points.

Example: Growing¶

Classes

GrowArrow

Introduce anArrowby growing it from its start toward its tip.

GrowFromCenter

Introduce anMobjectby growing it from its center.

GrowFromEdge

Introduce anMobjectby growing it from one of its bounding box edges.

GrowFromPoint

Introduce anMobjectby growing it from a point.

SpinInFromNothing

Introduce anMobjectspinning and growing it from its center.

code_examples.code:
class Growing(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        square = Square()
        circle = Circle()
        triangle = Triangle()
        arrow = Arrow(LEFT, RIGHT)
        star = Star()

        VGroup(square, circle, triangle).set_x(0).arrange(buff=1.5).set_y(2)
        VGroup(arrow, star).move_to(DOWN).set_x(0).arrange(buff=1.5).set_y(-2)

        self.play(GrowFromPoint(square, ORIGIN))
        self.play(GrowFromCenter(circle))
        self.play(GrowFromEdge(triangle, DOWN))
        self.play(GrowArrow(arrow))
        self.play(SpinInFromNothing(star))
